steps.note: Open the single-stage create screen required for selecting a price-based auction.
Configure the event as a price-based auction.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the competing bids.
Populate the pricing sheet so the auction can be published.
Invite two vendors so the auction has two bidding participants.
Confirm the auction reached a real published project page.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Confirm the trailing vendor's bid was accepted.
View the auction as the trailing vendor.
Open the live auction pricing view in the supplier portal.
Confirm the vendor-facing best-price indicator is present.
Check that the displayed best price matches the leading bid.
